description: The chart, Figure 5, illustrates the performance gain achieved through predictive rollout search, comparing the performance gap between VisuoThink without rollout search and VisuoThink. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with task types, and are ordered in a specific sequence. The vertical axis represents the performance gain percentage, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 0% to 60%, and tick labels at regular intervals of 10%. The bars are grouped into two categories, with one set colored blue and the other orange, representing different models or conditions, as indicated by the legend or labels. The blue bars have values ranging from around 10% to 55%, with the tallest bar reaching approximately 54% and the shortest around 12%. The orange bars have values ranging from around 5% to 20%, with the tallest bar at approximately 18% and the shortest at around 6%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
